formats.key: recordDecision(address _agent, string _action, address _assetInvolved, uint256 _value, bool _success, bytes32 _txHash)
effects: Only the owner or auditorRegistry can call it; no tokens or ETH move and no approvals are set.
Adds a decision record (action, asset, value, success, tx hash) to the agent's history.
Adds _value to the agent's totalValueManaged and bumps totalDecisions and lastActivityAt.
Changes the agent's reputation: +5 (max 1000) on success, -50 on failure.
If reputation falls below 300 while the agent is ACTIVE, the agent is automatically SUSPENDED and set inactive.
formats.shown: Record A2A decision, with the agent, action text, asset address, raw value, success flag and tx hash.

findings.title: recordDecision shows _value as a raw integer when the asset is in the same calldata.
findings.evidence: descriptor field {path:_value, format:raw}; case 2 shows Value '2500000000' for USDC 0x8335...2913 (meaning 2,500 USDC). Code: totalValueManaged += _value.

findings.title: recordDecision intent leaves out the reputation change and the possible automatic suspension of the agent.
findings.evidence: AgentIdentityRegistry.sol recordDecision -> _updateReputation: +5 or -50, and status = SUSPENDED when reputationScore < 300. Intent: 'Record A2A decision'.
findings.fix: Use an intent such as 'Record agent decision (updates reputation)', and label _success as 'Success (raises/lowers reputation)'.

findings.title: recordDecision intent uses the jargon 'A2A', which a normal signer will not know.

cases.notes: Synthetic case with no mined tx. Nothing of the signer's moves; the value appears raw.

findings.title: recordIncident intent leaves out the 50-point reputation cut and the possible automatic suspension.
findings.evidence: AgentIdentityRegistry.sol recordIncident: _updateReputation(_agent, false, _description) -> reputationScore -= 50; status = SUSPENDED if < 300. Intent: 'Record agent incident'.
findings.fix: Use an intent such as 'Record agent incident (-50 reputation)'.

formats.key: registerAgent(address _agentWallet, address _ownerWallet, uint8 _agentType, string _name, string _version, string _manufacturer, string _serialNumber, uint256 _minColScore, uint256 _maxLTV)
effects: Only the contract owner can call it; no assets move.
Registers _agentWallet as an ACTIVE agent with reputation 750 and the given type, name, version, minimum COL score (<=1000) and max LTV (<=10000 bps).
Makes _ownerWallet the agent owner, which lets it call setMandateRegistry, setCapabilities and updateFirmware for this agent.
For Physical or Hybrid agents with a serial, binds the serial number to the agent wallet.
formats.shown: Register agent ERC-8240, with every parameter shown: wallets, type enum, name, version, manufacturer, serial, raw min score and raw max LTV.

findings.title: registerAgent intent cites 'ERC-8240', but the contract says it implements ERC-8004.
findings.evidence: AgentIdentityRegistry.sol header '@dev Implémente ERC-8004 + prépare ERC-8XXX'; descriptor intent 'Register agent ERC-8240'.
findings.fix: Use 'Register agent' and drop the unverified standard number.

findings.title: registerAgent shows Max LTV raw in basis points; 6000 means 60%.
findings.evidence: registerAgent: require(_maxLTV <= 10000); case 1 shows Max LTV '6000'.
findings.fix: Use format unit with params {base:'%', decimals:2}, or label it 'Max LTV (bps)'. Label Min Score as 'Min COL score (0-1000)'.
